articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (TXSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, announced today that its common stock commenced trading at market open on the Texas Stock Exchange ("TXSE") under its current ticker symbol, "OBK". The commencement of trading completes Origin’s previously announced transfer of its stock exchange listing from the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") to the TXSE.
articles.title: Origin Bancorp, Inc. Begins Trading on Texas | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) (“Origin”), the financial holding company for Origin Bank, plans to issue third quarter 2026 results after the market closes on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, and hold a conference call to discuss such results on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. Central Time (9:00 a.m. Eastern Time). The conference call will be hosted by Drake Mills, Chairman, President and CEO of Origin, William J. Wallace, IV, Chief Financial Officer of Origin, and Lance Hall, President and CEO of Origin Bank.
articles.title: Origin Bancorp, Inc. Announces Third Quarter | Origin Bank

articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (TXSE: OBK) (“Origin,” “we,” “our” or the “Company”), the holding company for Origin Bank (the “Bank”), today announced net income of $37.8 million, or $1.22 diluted earnings per share (“EPS”), for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to net income of $33.8 million, or $1.09 diluted EPS, for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Pre-tax, pre-provision (“PTPP”)(1) earnings were $50.7 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to $43.2 million for the linked quarter.

articles.summary: Origin Bancorp, Inc. (NYSE: OBK) ("Origin"), the holding company for Origin Bank, today announced that on October 28, 2026, its board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.28 per share of its common stock. The cash dividend will be paid on November 30, 2026, to stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 13, 2026.

articles.summary: Origin Bank today announced Austin Lewis has been promoted to the role of North Texas regional president. For the past 16 years, Lewis has dedicated his time at Origin to building relationships and serving customers. He has specialized in commercial and private banking strategies for middle-market operating companies and high-net-worth individuals, as well as local and national real estate companies.
articles.title: Origin Bank Promotes Austin Lewis to North Texas | Origin Bank
